note: All 200 pages of the Telang DLI scan, for the full-book walk, as a series of its own (telang-dli-book-page-NNN) so that the 15 pages rendered earlier as telang-dli-page-NNN keep their renders. Preprocessing, chosen by a survey of the raw pages on 2026-11-06: 'flatten' where method 043's line analysis failed or took more than a fifth of a non-blank page as ink (pages 1, 5-12, 158, 200); 'rotate_cw' for the index tables printed sideways (pages 35-50). Render with: uv run --offline python inputs/render_pages.py inputs/pages-telang-book.json
